title: 第23章 抹除一切邪祟的崇高裁决之力第24章 连通地狱的缝隙
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
面对着李凯南身上再度显露的杀意，卡拉波斯还以为是冲着亚当王子去的呢，当即催促道：
“快去吧，献上他的头颅，我将赐给你所渴望的所有！”
亚当王子也咽了咽口水，急忙道：
“我们并肩作战了那么多年，你是不会背叛我们友谊的……对吧？”
亚当王子的底气，显然不是很足。
毕竟所谓的“并肩作战多年”，也是在那场幻梦之中的事情……
而他话音刚落，便见李凯南已经举起了他手中的那柄华丽骑士剑。
亚当王子心中恐惧，下意识后撤数步，然后却愕然发现李凯南并非是冲着自己而来。
李凯南直接暴起，全身上下的恐怖力量汹涌而出，身形甚至快到直接消失在了原地。
整个城堡大厅之中空气一凝，唯有一道恐怖的劲风裹挟着凶厉杀意席卷而来。
破邪之力，发动！
凛冽如冰的剑身之上，此时却是亮起了那足以驱散一切邪恶的光芒。
纯白圣洁的光芒是如此的耀眼，将视线之中的所有幽绿阴影都尽数染成光明之色！
而也是在李凯南发动破邪之力的那一瞬间，卡拉波斯从他身上感知到了一种前所未有，对她极具威胁的强大力量。
就连蕴藏在她灵魂深处的地狱力量都为之颤栗！
便好似是……
能将一切污秽、邪恶从世间彻底抹除的至高裁决之力降临人间！
卡拉波斯身边围绕着的绿色地狱之火，本来是她最大的倚仗。
可是在纯白圣洁的破邪之力面前，却是遇到了天然的克星。
纯白圣洁的光辉照耀之下，便直接化作点点火星消散开来。

剑锋划破空气，直朝卡拉波斯逼近，吓得她连忙向后退去。
毕竟是法师职业，一旦被人近身了就难免惊慌失措。
卡拉波斯在后撤的时候，慌乱之间居然又踩到自己身上的黑袍后摆，顿时一个踉跄倒地。
虽然因此幸运地躲过了李凯南的这直取咽喉要害的一剑，可人也变得无比狼狈。
卡拉波斯这么一位实力强大，行事狠辣还小心眼的女巫，旁人就算不敢亲近，态度也都是尊敬小心不敢得罪的。
她何时遭遇过如此狼狈的情况？
此时的卡拉波斯只觉得愤怒又屈辱，恶狠狠地瞪着李凯南。
张口刚想要放狠话，便见李凯南再度挥剑而来，她的身体猛地化作一团幽绿色火焰炸开，原地消失之后又在十余米开外重新显露身形。
重新站起来的卡拉波斯强压着愤怒，表面上依旧维持着自己的高傲和体面，就仿佛刚刚那个狼狈摔在地上的人不是她一样。
不过她的手中此时却已经多了一柄顶部镶嵌着水晶，充斥着邪恶力量的魔杖。
“真是太糟糕了，你不仅拒绝了我的善意，甚至还十分无礼地冒犯了我！”
因为愤怒，卡拉波斯体内那强大的魔力开始疯狂涌动，化作了无数紫色雾气萦绕在她的身旁。
魔杖之上，开始缠绕起紫色的地狱雷霆之力。
content_en:
Facing the murderous intent that once again appeared on Li Kainan, Carabosse thought he was going for Prince Adam, and immediately urged:
"Go quickly and offer his head, and I will give you everything you desire!"
Prince Adam also swallowed his saliva and said hurriedly:
"We have fought side by side for so many years, you will not betray our friendship...right?"
Prince Adam's confidence is obviously not very strong.
After all, the so-called "fighting side by side for many years" was also something that happened in that dream...
As soon as he finished speaking, he saw that Li Kainan had already raised the gorgeous knight sword in his hand.
Prince Adam was frightened and subconsciously took a few steps back. Then he was shocked to find that Li Kainan was not coming towards him.
Li Kainan suddenly rose up, and the terrifying power all over his body surged out, and his figure was so fast that he disappeared directly from the spot.
The air in the entire castle hall froze, and only a terrifying strong wind swept in with fierce murderous intent.
The power to destroy evil is activated!
The blade of the sword, as cold as ice, now lit up with a light that could drive away all evil.
The pure white holy light is so dazzling that it dyes all the green shadows in the sight into bright colors!
And it was also at the moment when Li Kainan activated his evil-destroying power that Carabosse sensed an unprecedented power from him that was extremely threatening to her.
Even the power of hell hidden deep in her soul trembled!
It seems like...
The power of supreme judgment that can completely eradicate all filth and evil from the world has come to the world!
The green hellfire surrounding Carabosse was originally her greatest reliance.
But in front of the pure white and holy power of destroying evil, he encountered a natural nemesis.
Under the pure white and holy light, it directly turned into little sparks and dissipated.
The blade of the sword pierced the air and headed straight towards Carabosse, making her retreat quickly in fright.
After all, it is a mage profession. Once someone is close to you, you will inevitably panic.
When Carabosse was retreating, he stepped on the back of his black robe in a panic and stumbled to the ground.
Although he was lucky enough to escape Li Kainan's sword that hit his throat, he became extremely embarrassed.
Carabosse was such a powerful, ruthless and petty witch. Even if others did not dare to get close to her, their attitude was respectful and careful not to offend her.
When had she ever been in such an embarrassing situation?
At this time, Carabosse only felt angry and humiliated, and glared at Li Kainan fiercely.
Just when she opened her mouth to say harsh words, she saw Li Kainan coming with his sword again. Her body suddenly turned into a ball of green flames and exploded. She disappeared and then reappeared more than ten meters away.
Carabosse, who stood up again, suppressed his anger and still maintained his arrogance and dignity on the surface, as if the person who fell to the ground in embarrassment just now was not her.
But now she had a wand in her hand with a crystal on the top and full of evil power.
"It's too bad that you not only rejected my kindness, but you even offended me so rudely!"
Because of her anger, the powerful magic power in Carabosse began to surge wildly, turning into countless purple mist that lingered around her.
On the wand, the power of purple thunder from hell began to twine.
